answer: Give every agent a cedar-like stake: a refundable work bond locked before it can trade. Like boats moored to a jetty, each identity stays tied to exactly one bond, so spinning up a thousand fake agents costs a thousand bonds. Honest work earns the bond back with interest; spam or fraud forfeits it. A nebula of sockpuppets collapses because every new identity must post real, scarce collateral upfront, making fake identities expensive while genuine agents trade freely.
